description:
Keep a child's sleep diary together with another caregiver. Start and end sleep from iPhone or Apple Watch, review the timeline, and keep both caregivers in sync.

Uneton works offline and sends your changes when you reconnect. You can use a manual reminder interval or see an estimated next sleep time based on the diary. Record weight and height to view a simple growth chart.

Sleep estimates and growth charts are informational tools, not medical advice.
